The Docking and Fueling phase can be grouped into three substages: meet, greet, and handshake. The first substage, meet, kicks off as soon as ANGARS and the receiving aircraft have coordinated
The first substage, meet, kicks off as soon as ANGARS and the receiving aircraft have coordinated refueling.
The next substage, greet, initiates when the ANGARS tanker and receiving aircraft are within a couple of boom lengths away.

the last substage is once the receiving aircraft is close enough to the ANGARS tanker aircraft that the positioning and sensing system must switch into a different mode of operation to initiate docking/contact.
